metadata.color_semantics: Claude fidelity skin throughout. beats.narration: Inkling: nine hundred seventy-five billion parameters, images and audio in, no separate encoder. Big claims. Which of them can I actually check?
beats.narration_text: Inkling: (1) read config.json and map all 66 layers, (2) compute what its attention costs at 1M tokens, (3) mark every architecture claim verified, ambiguous or trust — with the receipt for each.

props.command: Inkling: (1) read config.json and map all 66 layers, (2) compute what its attention costs at 1M tokens, (3) mark every architecture claim verified, ambiguous or trust — with the receipt for each.

beats.narration: Here's the method, for any open model. One, read the config. Two, compute the cost. Three, check each claim against a receipt. Four, ask what would break it.
beats.narration_text: Here's the method, for any open model. One, read the config. Two, compute the cost. Three, check each claim against a receipt. Four, ask what would break it.

props.heading: The audit — four steps, any open model

moves.label: READ
moves.detail: Every number starts in config.json, not in the announcement.

moves.label: COMPUTE
moves.detail: Turn the config into a cost — memory, in bytes.

moves.label: CHECK
moves.detail: Mark each claim verified, ambiguous or trust, by its receipt.

moves.label: BREAK
moves.detail: Name the result that would prove a claim wrong. Look for it.

props.keepNote: Step 3 is the verdict. Steps 1 and 2 are how you earn it.
props.source: Computational Skepticism method · applied below to thinkingmachines/Inkling

beats.narration: Step one, read. Of sixty-six layers, fifty-five slide over a five hundred twelve token window; every sixth is global. After two dense layers, each token runs six of two hundred fifty-six experts, plus two shared.
beats.narration_text: Step one, read. Of sixty-six layers, fifty-five slide over a five hundred twelve token window; every sixth is global. After two dense layers, each token runs six of two hundred fifty-six experts, plus two shared.

props.heading: 66 layers, counted two ways
props.axisNote: layers, of 66 — attention and feed-forward are two views of one stack
props.exception: One global layer in six. That ratio sets the memory bill in step 2.
props.source: thinkingmachines/Inkling config.json: local_layer_ids · sliding_window_size 512 · n_routed_experts 256 · num_experts_per_tok 6 · n_shared_experts 2 · model.safetensors.index.json

beats.narration: Local layers keep sixteen key value heads, global just eight. No rotary embedding: a learned relative position bias instead, plus short convolutions. Remember that position claim.
beats.narration_text: Local layers keep sixteen key value heads, global just eight. No rotary embedding: a learned relative position bias instead, plus short convolutions. Remember that position claim.

props.heading: How attention is wired

moves.label: LOCAL
moves.detail: 64 query heads · 16 key-value heads · 512-token window.

moves.label: GLOBAL
moves.detail: 64 query heads · 8 key-value heads · the whole context.

moves.label: POSITION
moves.detail: A learned relative-position bias — no RoPE anywhere.

moves.label: CONV
moves.detail: Short convolutions, kernel 4, on K/V and residual branches.

props.keepNote: Row 3 is a design claim, not just a setting. Step 3 checks its evidence.
props.source: thinkingmachines/Inkling config.json · Thinking Machines, Introducing Inkling (Jul 15, 2026)

beats.narration: Images enter as forty-pixel patches through a four-layer network; audio, as a discrete mel spectrogram. Both join the text stream. No separate encoder: the decoder perceives.
beats.narration_text: Images enter as forty-pixel patches through a four-layer network; audio, as a discrete mel spectrogram. Both join the text stream. No separate encoder: the decoder perceives.

props.heading: No separate encoder

moves.label: IMAGE
moves.detail: 40×40-pixel patches → a 4-layer hMLP → the decoder.

moves.label: AUDIO
moves.detail: 16 kHz audio → dMel, 80 mel bins × 16 levels → the decoder.

moves.label: TEXT
moves.detail: Tokens from a 201,024-entry vocabulary → the decoder.

moves.label: STREAM
moves.detail: All three share one 6,144-wide stream through 66 layers.

props.keepNote: Checkable: a 4-layer patch MLP and dMel tokens — no separate vision transformer or audio encoder.
props.source: thinkingmachines/Inkling config.json: vision_config · audio_config · model card (WAV at 16 kHz)

beats.narration: Step two, compute. One global layer: eight heads, times one twenty-eight dimensions, times two for keys and values, times two bytes, times a million tokens. Four point three gigabytes. All sixty-six global: two eighty-three. Inkling's eleven: forty-seven.
beats.narration_text: Step two, compute. One global layer: eight heads, times one twenty-eight dimensions, times two for keys and values, times two bytes, times a million tokens. Four point three gigabytes. All sixty-six global: two eighty-three. Inkling's eleven: forty-seven.

props.heading: KV cache at 1,048,576 tokens, BF16

moves.label: ONE LAYER
moves.detail: 8 KV heads × 128 dims × 2 (K, V) × 2 bytes × 1,048,576 = 4.29 GB

moves.label: ALL GLOBAL
moves.detail: 66 layers × 4.29 GB = 283 GB — the cost without the 5:1 split.

moves.label: INKLING
moves.detail: 11 global layers × 4.29 GB = 47 GB.

moves.label: LOCAL
moves.detail: 55 layers × 16 heads × 128 × 2 × 2 B × 512 tokens = 0.23 GB.

props.keepNote: Six-fold smaller, straight from the config. Computed — before any serving overhead.
props.source: Computed from thinkingmachines/Inkling config.json: num_key_value_heads 8 · head_dim 128 · swa_num_key_value_heads 16 · model_max_length 1048576

beats.narration: Now the tension. The cache drops from two eighty-three to forty-seven. But each token reads eighty-two gigabytes of weights, and the checkpoint is one point nine terabytes: every expert must stay in memory. Sparse compute isn't sparse memory.
beats.narration_text: Now the tension. The cache drops from two eighty-three to forty-seven. But each token reads eighty-two gigabytes of weights, and the checkpoint is one point nine terabytes: every expert must stay in memory. Sparse compute isn't sparse memory.

props.spark: Cheap to run, not cheap to hold.
props.heading: What has to fit in memory — GB
props.exception: The attention saving trims the small bars. Every expert still has to be resident.
props.source: model.safetensors.index.json total_size 1,904,604,285,204 bytes · 41B active (model card) · 283, 47 and 82 GB computed

beats.narration: Step three, check. Layer pattern and encoder-free inputs: verified in the config. Parameter count: ambiguous. At two bytes each, the checkpoint holds about nine fifty-two billion. Relative position beating rope: no ablation published. Trust.
beats.narration_text: Step three, check. Layer pattern and encoder-free inputs: verified in the config. Parameter count: ambiguous. At two bytes each, the checkpoint holds about nine fifty-two billion. Relative position beating rope: no ablation published. Trust.

props.heading: Claims vs receipts

moves.label: VERIFIED
moves.detail: 5:1 local/global attention with a 512-token window.

moves.label: VERIFIED
moves.detail: Encoder-free image and audio input.

moves.label: AMBIGUOUS
moves.detail: 975B stated · checkpoint 1.905 TB ÷ 2 bytes ≈ 952B.

moves.label: TRUST
moves.detail: Relative position “performs better” than RoPE.

props.keepNote: Ambiguous isn't wrong — precision or counting could explain the gap. The config can't settle it.
props.source: Thinking Machines, Introducing Inkling (Jul 15, 2026) · model card · config.json · model.safetensors.index.json

beats.narration: Step four, what would break it? Swap each image for noise. If the answers hold, the decoder isn't perceiving. The lab flags soft spots too: not the strongest model, contaminated solutions scored zero, forecasting on another checkpoint.
beats.narration_text: Step four, what would break it? Swap each image for noise. If the answers hold, the decoder isn't perceiving. The lab flags soft spots too: not the strongest model, contaminated solutions scored zero, forecasting on another checkpoint.

props.heading: Break tests, and what the lab flags

moves.label: TEST
moves.detail: Swap each image or clip for noise. If answers hold, it isn't perceiving.

moves.label: RANK
moves.detail: “Not the strongest overall model available today, open or closed.”

moves.label: LEAKAGE
moves.detail: Some Terminal Bench 2.1 solutions were contaminated → scored 0.

moves.label: CHECKPOINT
moves.detail: Forecasting scores come from a different checkpoint than released.

props.keepNote: Row 1 is a result that would break “the decoder perceives”. The lab's flags show where else to aim.
props.source: Thinking Machines, Introducing Inkling (Jul 15, 2026) · test design: input-ablation (noise swap)

beats.narration: Verdict. Encoder-free at scale: real. The cache cut: real, but the weights still need nearly two terabytes. The position claim: unproven. Open weights, not open data.
beats.narration_text: Verdict. Encoder-free at scale: real. The cache cut: real, but the weights still need nearly two terabytes. The position claim: unproven. Open weights, not open data.

artifactLines: Verified: 5:1 local/global attention and encoder-free inputs, in config.json.
Computed: 47 GB of KV cache at 1M tokens vs 283 GB all-global — beside 1.9 TB of weights.
Ambiguous: 975B stated; the BF16 checkpoint implies about 952B.
Trust: relative position over RoPE (no ablation); weights Apache 2.0, training data not released.
props.sourceNote: config.json · model.safetensors.index.json · model card · Thinking Machines, Jul 15 2026
